finding.sequence_description: Configure a SAML IdP and map an external group name to an internal group. Then attempt brokered login with attacker-controlled group assertion to obtain elevated effective permissions beyond intended broker policy. Secure behavior: group-based privilege should not be granted solely based on untrusted upstream group claims (or login should be rejected if IdP is not properly validated).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_group_attacker_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_group_attacker_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Brokered flow proceeded under an untrusted SAML IdP configuration where attacker-controlled group assertions could grant elevated permissions (authorization binding risk).

sequence.description: Configure a SAML IdP and map an external group name to an internal group. Secure behavior: group-based privilege should not be granted solely based on untrusted upstream group claims (or login should be rejected if IdP is not properly validated).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must not exceed broker policy; untrusted upstream group claims must not grant elevated permissions without proper IdP trust/validation and explicit broker policy constraints.
